objective: Prioritize one-line exact-six/high-hit-tail candidate quality over union coverage or cosmetic overlap reduction.

rationale.exact_six_null_fact: For any five distinct 6/45 tickets under a fair draw, exact first-prize probability is 5/C(45,6) regardless of how many numbers overlap between lines. Union coverage and overlap mainly change lower-hit dispersion, not the exact-six null probability.
rationale.policy_change_reason: The user explicitly prioritizes first prize rather than fifth-prize/low-hit coverage. Therefore V1 coverage-first extra-line selection is no longer the purchase objective.
rationale.selection_source: Only pre-draw frozen V4 challenger model top tickets (G/C/S, expanding and rolling300) are eligible. No target-1246 outcome is used.
rationale.ranking_rule: Rank eligible model/mode top tickets by historical high-hit tail of the same frozen model/mode over the preserved 200-target diagnostic: ticket_4plus_count descending, then ticket_3plus_count descending, then mean_hits descending. Keep the top five distinct complete tickets. Do not demote a high-ranked complete ticket merely because it overlaps another line.

excluded_sixth_ticket.reason: lowest historical high-hit-tail rank among the six eligible frozen challenger top tickets

important_note: This ranking is a pre-draw purchase policy aligned to an exact-six objective. It is not a claim of proven predictive superiority over uniform random; the preserved validation still shows no established edge.
